title: Prices and order updates come from a feed separate from the screens, on one relay (row 9 match)
reference_behaviour: One socket relay carries quotes and order updates to the browser; the browser reconnects with a back-off capped at 30 s (bundle-findings 1.7 and 6.1).
ours: REQ-113 AC-1: the market-data process owns every price socket and order stream; browser back-off is capped at 30 s.
